definitions.explanation: Physical or mental tiredness resulting from exertion or stress. A somewhat formal or technical term compared to the everyday {疲|つか}れ. Also used in medical and material science contexts (metal fatigue, etc.).

examples.japanese: {疲労|ひろう}が{溜|た}まっている。
{長時間|ちょうじかん}の{運転|うんてん}による{疲労|ひろう}で{事故|じこ}が{増|ふ}えている。
examples.english: Accidents are increasing due to fatigue from long hours of driving.

examples.japanese: {慢性的|まんせいてき}な{疲労|ひろう}を{感|かん}じている{人|ひと}は、{生活|せいかつ}{習慣|しゅうかん}を{見直|みなお}すことが{大切|たいせつ}です。
examples.english: For people experiencing chronic fatigue, it is important to review their lifestyle habits.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- {疲|つか}れ: tiredness — everyday, casual term
- {疲労|ひろう}: fatigue — more formal/technical, used in writing and medical contexts

USAGE:
Also functions as a する verb: {疲労|ひろう}する (to become fatigued). In technical contexts, {金属|きんぞく}{疲労|ひろう} (metal fatigue) refers to the weakening of materials under repeated stress.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {疲労|ひろう}が{溜|た}まる: fatigue builds up
- {疲労|ひろう}を{感|かん}じる: feel fatigue
- {疲労|ひろう}{回復|かいふく}: fatigue recovery
- {慢性|まんせい}{疲労|ひろう}: chronic fatigue
- {疲労|ひろう}{骨折|こっせつ}: stress fracture
